## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List tests and desktop checks actually performed, including skips or pending checks.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Originals remain protected and existing outputs are not overwritten.
- [ ] Slow operations run off the UI thread.
- [ ] Failures produce actionable messages.
- [ ] Documentation and format boundaries reflect the change.
- [ ] No private samples, logs or credentials are included.
